newsitem.title: UK: Triplex Lloyd makes bid for William Cook.
newsitem.headline: Triplex Lloyd makes bid for William Cook.

text.p: Triplex Lloyd Plc said on Friday that it is making a 57.7 million stg offer for William Cook Plc, valuing each share in the steel company at 309p.
Triplex, a UK engineering group, said the offer will be made on the basis of seven new Triplex Lloyd shares and 1350p in cash for every nine William Cook shares.
It said William Cook shareholders will also be offered a fully underwritten cash Alternative of 295p per William Cook Share. There is also a share election and a loan note alternative.
Triplex Lloyd said the enlarged group will sell cast products to customers in a broad range of industries in Europe, North America and Asia.
The company said that its proposed acquisition should add some 1.5 million stg to profits on an annualised basis.
